title: 第6章 山神庙的故事
content_zh:
第6章山神庙的故事
艹.张元清突然不想在主殿待下去了。
他有种身处绝境，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵的惶恐。
此处极端危险，可他却无法向外界求助，能依靠的只有自己。
犹豫再三，他牙一咬心一横，俯身把裹着工服的骷髅拉了出来。
拉扯过程中，劳保服被轻易撕裂，过去那么多年，衣服早就朽烂。
把尸体拖到烛光下，他忍着不适，开始检查起来。
人虽然死了，但身体会说话，弄清楚对方的死因，能帮自己规避很多危险。
“胸骨和肋骨断了几根，右肩有细密的裂纹，但不算严重.”
死者生前遭受过重创，但具体的死因，由于年代过于久远，看不出来。
接着，张元清又从工人前辈的口袋里，找到了几张发黄发脆的纸，很有些年头了。
纸上用楷体写着蝇头小字。
张元清心里一喜，纸张明显是工人前辈在庙里找到的，这有助于他了解这座古庙的情况。
借助烛光，他凝神
“昨晚又有一位师弟失踪，这已经是庙里第三个离奇失踪的同门。师兄弟们说，三道山闹了鬼，亦或者来了道行高深的妖精，每夜都要来庙里抓人吃，但庙里的诸多弟子修为伴身，师父更是方圆百里之内名声赫赫的真人，哪路妖精不开眼，敢来此处觅食。
“至于鬼怪，我的镇尸符和唤灵符足以解决，都不用劳烦师父。我心里有不好的预感，得去寻大师兄合计合计.”
“今天又有一人失踪，这是第五人，师父让我们瞒着香客，不然会影响庙里的香火，他一定知道些什么。我和大师兄打算夜里巡逻.”
“三天过去了，期间又有三人失踪，可我和大师兄没有发现端倪，夜晚风平浪静。我心里不详的预感更深了”
“大师兄今天很奇怪，他似乎发现了什么，显得非常愤怒，我询问他，可他没有告诉我。他情绪不太好，我还是明天再询问吧。”
“今天失踪的人是大师兄，我找遍了整个三道山也没发现他，我，我受不了了，我要去找师父问个清楚，庙里的师兄弟们也支持我，因为他们也很害怕.”

这段话的字迹有些潦草，可见笔记的主人心态有些崩溃了。
张元清继续往下看：
“经过我的一番追问，师父终于答应告诉我真相，我的预感没错，他果然知道师弟们离奇失踪的原因。但师父说，白日里人多嘴杂，太阳落山后他会来房间找我，告诉我一桩天大的秘密，这个秘密关系到数千年来的兴衰。”
“用完晚膳，我便在房间里等待着，等待日落，自从夜里有人失踪后，我从未有一天如此期待过天黑”
纸张记录的内容到此为止。
没了？这断章让人有点难受啊.张元清一阵龇牙咧嘴。
他梳理了一下纸张里的信息，在某一年间，这座山神庙的弟子接二连三的诡异消失。
弟子们束手无策，恐慌的情绪蔓延。而这件事，庙里的庙祝，也就是他们师父，似乎知道原因。
这个原因关乎着一个数千年兴衰的大秘密。
“山神庙衰败的原因未知，探索出这个源头，是不是就能完成第二个主线任务？”张元清作出猜测。
他把发脆的纸张放回尸骸的劳保服里，把对方推回桌底，来个眼不见为净，接着思考起自己下一步要做什么。
“主殿信息就这么多，既然要探索古庙，肯定就得出去，这样的话，就必须直面庙里的危险”
“在佘灵隧道的怪谈里，是有一位工人成功活下来的，循着他的轨迹，说不定能找出活下来的办法。”
深思熟虑后，张元清走到主殿门口，
“吱~”
木制门轴发出让人牙酸的声响。
他撑着门框，探出脑袋左顾右盼，外面寂寂无声，除了有些荒凉阴森，没看到危险。
观察了一阵后，他踏出门槛，沿着主殿左侧的鹅软石小道，朝着山神庙后院走去。
月华如水，荒草起伏，张元清走了一两分钟，前方出现一片建筑。
那是几座相连的平房，形成一个面积极大的四合院，黑瓦白墙，一字型的屋脊，檐下是格子窗和格子门。

一扇扇格子门灰扑扑的，或开或倒或紧闭，用来糊窗的纸在岁月的侵蚀下，破破烂烂。
月光皎皎，如地凝霜，他借着月华扫了一眼山神庙后院的格局。
除了眼前的四合院，东侧还有一个拱形的门，有点像影视剧里大户人家的后宅，都会有这么一座拱形门用来连接不同的院子。
隔壁那个院子里种了一个参天大树，枝叶茂盛，树枝虬结。
他在荒草起伏的院子里，发现了几具裹着劳保服的骷髅。
小心的靠拢过去，仔细检查了一番，每一具骷髅的损坏严重，劳保服下是一截截断骨，但除了主殿那具，这里的骷髅肩骨保存完好，没有裂缝。
“这些人死前都遭受了可怕的重创，死的很惨.”
一阵风吹来，枝叶“沙沙”作响，隐约间，张元清听见风带过来的“沙沙”声里，夹杂着如泣如诉的低语：
“救命，救命”
在这荒败死寂的夜里，张元清后背沁出了冷汗。
他浑身僵硬的站在原地，好一会儿，风停了，哀泣的低语也随风而止。
隔壁那座院子好像有点危险啊，不过里头的东西没有过来.他无声吐出一口气，踏着满院的荒草，走入屋檐，打算探索这座四合院。
这里似乎是庙中弟子生活的地方，堆积着破旧的，布满灰尘的家具，空气中弥漫着淡淡的、腐朽的气息。
张元清挨个的探索房间，没有什么特别的发现，直到推开最东边的那扇格子门。
“咯吱~”
尘封不知多少岁月的房门再次被推开，灰尘簌簌掉落，张元清拍了拍落在肩膀的灰尘，目光戒备的扫过房间每一个角落。
在这间荒废多年的房间里，窗边的位置，有一具尸体靠着墙，歪斜的躺在那里。
从服饰和滚落的矿工帽可以推断出，又是一位前辈。
跨过门槛，进入房间，张元清打了个哆嗦，莫名的觉得周围的温度似乎下降许多。
“有点冷”

他谨慎的靠向那具尸体，解开破烂的衣衫，照例观察了一下尸体骨骼情况，这一次，他没有看到碎裂的骨骼，这具骷髅保存完好。
可当他把目光投向尸骸的肩骨，瞳孔一凝，在这具尸骸的肩骨上，有着夸张的裂缝。
这和主殿那具尸体肩膀的裂纹一样，区别在于眼前这具尸骸受到的伤更重。
“只有屋子里这具和主殿那具肩骨碎裂，是巧合吗？”他有些不安的自语。
接着，张元清发现尸体的裤兜鼓胀胀的，似乎藏着什么东西。
伸手掏了掏，从死者裤兜里掏出一本泛黄的古册，一面灰扑扑的铜镜，一张黄纸符。
黄纸符上用朱砂画着扭曲的纹路，有点类似符文，这些纹路共同汇聚成一个神似繁体的“尸”字。
正审视着黄纸符，张元清眼前浮现一条荧蓝色的信息：
【名称：镇尸符】
【类型：消耗品】
【功能：镇尸】
【介绍：强大的夜游神制造的符箓，是一切尸类阴物的克星。把它贴在阴物的额头就能完成封印。】
【备注：它只能使用一次。】
荧蓝色的信息有点像他的属性面板，显而易见，这是“灵境”给出的提示。
张元清进入诡异的古庙以来，还是第一次看到这种提示。
“应该是重要的物品。”张元清把它折叠好，收进冲锋衣的口袋里，拉上拉链。
想了想，又把拉链重新
因为他想起了一部武侠小说里的梗，某个剑术高超的剑客，喜欢用布条裹着剑背在身上。
有一天，一位挑战者在剑客吃饭的时候，向他发起挑战。
然后剑客就无了。

死因是布条拆开不便
张元清接着拿起古册和铜镜，没有浮现相关的信息。
他先把铜镜放在一旁，小心翼翼的翻开页脚卷起，发黄易脆的册子。
上面写道：
“拜入三道山娘娘庙已经两年半了，我已经学会识字和书写，大师兄说，等师父超度亡魂回山，就可以正式引我入门，修行吞月养魂术。这是成为夜游神的入门之法。”
“燕王叛乱，狼烟四起，师父身为松府夜游神一脉的最强之人，不得不下山超度亡者，否则战事未定，阴祸再起，百姓就更加不得安宁.”
张元清觉得肩膀有些酸疼，揉了揉，初步判断，这是一本随笔，也就是日记。
日记的内容都是‘作者’在庙中修行、生活的经历，根据字迹，这本日记和主殿尸骸身上的纸张，同出一源。
通过“燕王叛乱”之类的字眼，时间线是靖难之役那段历史。
但他不确定这座庙是否真的存在于历史中，因为随笔里的内容写着“修行”“夜游神”“吐纳术”“符箓”等不明觉厉的词。
张元清活动了一下发酸的肩膀，警惕的扫一眼房间，倾听屋外动静，确定没有异常后，继续
很快，他翻到了主殿内容的后续，前头几页被撕掉了，后续内容写着：
“日落，天终于黑了，我听见了敲门声，兴匆匆的
“失踪一天一夜的大师兄回来了，但我没有任何喜悦，因为他已经死了，回来的是一具尸体。他的胸口鲜血淋漓，心脏不知道被谁挖走。”
“大师兄直勾勾的盯着我，他说：不要相信师父.”
这几段字，写的歪歪扭扭，可以想象，随笔的主人写这段内容的时候，心态是炸裂的。
张元清再翻下一页时，发现笔记没有后续了，日记的主人再也没有写过日记。
“嘶不要相信师父是什么意思？”
张元清被这个反转惊的心里发寒。
是庙祝杀死了那位大师兄？弟子们接二连三失踪的罪魁祸首也是他？张元清揉了揉肩膀，把册子放回了尸体的口袋里，接着，拿起铜镜，正要离开。

可当他眼角余光，无意间瞥了一眼铜镜，身躯陡然僵硬。
月光如水，投射在镜面，铜镜里映出了他的模样，而在他背上，趴着一个人。
那人脸色惨白，嘴唇深紫，有着一双白瞳，脑袋侧着枕在张元清肩上，那双白瞳，死寂的盯着他。
ps：这本书有灵异元素，但不是主打灵异，不喜欢灵异的读者可以放心。
content_en:
Chapter 6 The Story of the Mountain Temple
Fuck. Zhang Yuanqing suddenly didn’t want to stay in the main hall anymore.
He felt terrified that he was in a desperate situation, and that the heaven and earth were not responding, and that the earth and the earth were not working.
It was extremely dangerous here, but he couldn't ask for help from the outside world. He could only rely on himself.
After hesitating again and again, he gritted his teeth and leaned over to pull out the skeleton wrapped in work clothes.
During the pulling process, the labor protection clothing was easily torn. Over the past many years, the clothing had long since decayed.
Dragging the body to the candlelight, he endured the discomfort and began to examine it.
Although people are dead, their bodies can speak, and figuring out the cause of death can help you avoid many dangers.
"A few of the sternum and ribs were broken, and there were fine cracks on the right shoulder, but they were not serious."
The deceased had suffered severe injuries during his lifetime, but the specific cause of death could not be determined because it was too old.
Then, Zhang Yuanqing found several yellow and brittle pieces of paper from the pockets of the senior workers. They were quite old.
Written in small italics on the paper.
Zhang Yuanqing was delighted. The paper was obviously found in the temple by a senior worker, which helped him understand the situation of this ancient temple.
With the help of candlelight, he concentrated
"Another junior disciple disappeared last night. This is the third disciple in the temple who has disappeared mysteriously. The junior brothers said that there is a ghost in Sandao Mountain, or there are demons with advanced Taoism. They come to the temple every night to catch people and eat them. However, many disciples in the temple have cultivated skills to accompany them, and the master is a real person with a great reputation within a hundred miles. No demon dares to come here to look for food.
"As for the ghosts, my corpse-suppressing talisman and spirit-calling talisman are enough to deal with them, so I don't need to bother Master. I have a bad feeling in my heart, so I have to go find Senior Brother to figure it out."
"Another person is missing today. This is the fifth person. Master asked us to hide it from the pilgrims, otherwise it will affect the incense in the temple. He must know something. Senior brother and I plan to patrol at night."
"Three days have passed, during which three more people disappeared, but senior brother and I found no clues, and the night was calm. The ominous premonition in my heart deepened."
"Elder brother was very strange today. He seemed to have discovered something and seemed very angry. I asked him, but he didn't tell me. He's not in a good mood. I'd better ask him tomorrow. "
"The person who disappeared today is senior brother. I searched all over Sandao Mountain and couldn't find him. I, I can't stand it anymore. I want to go to the master and ask for details. The brothers in the temple also support me because they are also afraid."
The handwriting of this paragraph is a bit sloppy, which shows that the owner of the note has a somewhat broken mentality.
Zhang Yuanqing continued reading:
"After my questioning, the master finally agreed to tell me the truth. My hunch was right. He really knew the reason for the mysterious disappearance of the junior brothers. But the master said that people talk a lot during the day, and after the sun sets, he will come to my room to find me and tell me a huge secret, which is related to the rise and fall of thousands of years. "
"After dinner, I waited in the room for the sunset. Ever since someone disappeared at night, I have never looked forward to the sunset so much."
So much for the paper record.
Gone? This fragment of chapter makes people feel a little uncomfortable. Zhang Yuanqing bared his teeth for a while.
He sorted through the information in the paper and found that in a certain year, the disciples of this mountain temple disappeared mysteriously one after another.
The disciples were helpless and panic spread. As for this matter, the temple's priest, their master, seemed to know the reason.
This reason is related to a big secret of the rise and fall of thousands of years.
"The reason for the decline of the mountain temple is unknown. If we find out the source, will we be able to complete the second main mission? "Zhang Yuanqing made a guess.
He put the brittle paper back into the corpse's labor protection suit, pushed the other person back to the bottom of the table, and then thought about what he would do next.
"There is only so much information about the main temple. Since you want to explore the ancient temple, you must go out. In this case,We must face the danger in the temple head on.”
"In the strange story of She Ling Tunnel, there is a worker who managed to survive. Following his trajectory, we might be able to find a way to survive. "
After careful consideration, Zhang Yuanqing walked to the door of the main hall.
"Squeak~"
The wooden door shaft made a tooth-grinding sound.
He leaned on the door frame and stuck his head out to look left and right. It was quiet outside. Apart from being a bit desolate and gloomy, he saw no danger.
After observing for a while, he stepped out of the threshold and walked along the soft stone path on the left side of the main hall towards the backyard of the mountain temple.
The moonlight was like water, and the grass was undulating. Zhang Yuanqing walked for a minute or two, and a building appeared in front of him.
They were several connected bungalows, forming a large courtyard with black tiles and white walls, a straight roof, and lattice windows and doors under the eaves.
The lattice doors were dusty, open, collapsed, or tightly closed. The paper used to cover the windows was tattered by the erosion of time.
The moonlight was bright, like frost on the ground. He used the moonlight to glance at the layout of the backyard of the mountain temple.
In addition to the courtyard in front of you, there is also an arched door on the east side. It is a bit like the back house of a wealthy family in movies and TV shows. There will be such an arched door to connect different courtyards.
There is a towering tree planted in the yard next door, with lush and gnarled branches.
He found several skeletons wrapped in labor protection clothing in the yard with rolling grass.
Carefully approached and inspected carefully. Each skeleton was severely damaged, with a broken bone under the labor insurance suit. But except for the one in the main hall, the shoulder bones of the skeletons here were well preserved and had no cracks.
"These people suffered terrible injuries before they died, and they died miserably."
A gust of wind blew, and the branches and leaves rustled. Vaguely, Zhang Yuanqing heard the rustling sound brought by the wind, mixed with a weeping whisper:
"Help, help"
In this desolate and silent night, cold sweat broke out on Zhang Yuanqing's back.
He stood stiffly in place for a while. The wind stopped, and the whimpering whispers also stopped with the wind.
The courtyard next door seemed a bit dangerous, but the things inside didn't come over. He let out a silent breath, walked through the grass in the courtyard, and walked into the eaves, intending to explore the courtyard.
This seems to be the place where the disciples in the temple live. There are old and dusty furniture piled up, and there is a faint smell of decay in the air.
Zhang Yuanqing explored the rooms one by one, but found nothing special until he opened the easternmost lattice door.
"Creak~"
The door that had been covered in dust for an unknown number of years was pushed open again, and the dust fell. Zhang Yuanqing patted the dust on his shoulders and scanned every corner of the room warily.
In this room that had been abandoned for many years, there was a body lying leaning against the wall by the window.
It can be inferred from the clothing and the rolled-off miner's hat that he is another senior.
After crossing the threshold and entering the room, Zhang Yuanqing shivered and inexplicably felt that the surrounding temperature seemed to have dropped a lot.
“A bit cold”
He cautiously leaned towards the corpse, untied the tattered clothes, and observed the skeleton of the corpse as usual. This time, he did not see any broken bones. The skeleton was well preserved.
But when he turned his gaze to the shoulder bones of the corpse, his pupils froze. There were exaggerated cracks on the shoulder bones of the corpse.
This was the same as the crack on the shoulder of the corpse in the main hall, but the difference was that the corpse in front of him was more seriously injured.
"Only the one in the house and the one in the main hall have broken shoulder bones. Is it a coincidence? "He said to himself somewhat uneasily.
Then, Zhang Yuanqing discovered that the corpse's trouser pockets were bulging, as if something was hidden.
He reached out and took out a yellowed ancient book, a dusty bronze mirror, and a yellow paper charm from the deceased's trouser pocket.
The yellow paper talisman is painted with cinnabar with twisted lines, somewhat similar to runes. These lines converge into a traditional Chinese character for "corpse".While examining the yellow paper talisman, a fluorescent blue message appeared in front of Zhang Yuanqing's eyes:
[Name: Corpse Suppression Talisman]
[Type: Consumables]
[Function: Corpse suppression]
[Introduction: The talisman made by the powerful Night Travel God is the nemesis of all zombies and evil creatures. Apply it to the forehead of the vagina to complete the seal. 】
[Note: It can only be used once. 】
The fluorescent blue information is a bit like his attribute panel. It is obvious that this is a prompt given by the "Spiritual Realm".
This is the first time Zhang Yuanqing has seen such a prompt since he entered the strange ancient temple.
"It should be an important item." Zhang Yuanqing folded it, put it into the pocket of his jacket, and zipped it up.
After thinking about it, I re-zippered
Because he remembered a plot from a martial arts novel, where a certain swordsman with superb swordsmanship liked to wrap his sword in a cloth strip and carry it on his back.
One day, a challenger challenged the swordsman to a challenge while he was eating.
Then the swordsman is gone.
The cause of death was that it was inconvenient to take apart the cloth strips.
Zhang Yuanqing then picked up the ancient book and bronze mirror, but no relevant information emerged.
He first put the bronze mirror aside and carefully opened the book with rolled-up footers that was yellow and brittle.
It reads:
"It has been two and a half years since I joined the Sandaoshan Empress Temple. I have already learned to read and write. Senior Brother said that when the master returns the souls of the dead and returns to the mountain, he can officially introduce me to the practice of swallowing the moon and nourishing the soul. This is the entry-level method to become a night wandering god."
"The King of Yan rebelled, and the smoke spread everywhere. As the strongest person in the Songfu Yeyoushen lineage, the master had to go down the mountain to save the dead. Otherwise, the war is not settled, the evil disaster will happen again, and the people will be even more uneasy."
Zhang Yuanqing felt some pain in his shoulder, rubbed it, and initially judged that this was an essay, that is, a diary.
The contents of the diary are all the 'author's' experiences of practicing and living in the temple. According to the handwriting, this diary and the paper on the corpse in the main hall came from the same source.
Through words such as "King Yan's Rebellion", the timeline is the history of the Jingnan Campaign.
But he is not sure whether this temple really existed in history, because the content of the essay contains words such as "cultivation", "night wandering god", "tuna technique", "talisman" and other unclear and powerful words.
Zhang Yuanqing moved his aching shoulders, glanced at the room vigilantly, listened to the movement outside, and after confirming that there was nothing unusual, continued
Soon, he turned to the continuation of the content of the main hall. The first few pages were torn out, and the following content read:
"At sunset, it finally got dark. I heard a knock on the door, and I hurriedly
"My senior brother who has been missing for a day and a night is back, but I don't feel any joy because he is already dead and what comes back is a corpse. His chest was dripping with blood, and his heart was ripped out by someone. "
"Elder brother stared at me directly and said: Don't believe Master."
These few paragraphs are written crookedly. You can imagine that the author of the essay was in a state of mind when he wrote this content.
When Zhang Yuanqing turned to the next page, he found that there was no follow-up to the note. The owner of the diary never wrote a diary again.
"Hey, what do you mean, don't believe Master? "
Zhang Yuanqing was shocked by this reversal and felt chills in his heart.
Did Miao Zhu kill that senior brother? Is he also the culprit behind the disappearance of his disciples one after another? Zhang Yuanqing rubbed his shoulders, put the booklet back into the body's pocket, then picked up the bronze mirror and was about to leave.
But when he accidentally glanced at the bronze mirror from the corner of his eye, his body suddenly stiffened.
The moonlight was like water, projecting on the mirror. His appearance was reflected in the bronze mirror, and on his back, there was a person lying on his back.
The man's face was pale, his lips were deep purple, and he had a pair of white pupils. His head was resting on Zhang Yuanqing's shoulder, and his white pupils were staring at him deathly.
